rules.persistence: A world trace remains addressable after creation. Later chapters may reactivate, transform, contest or supersede it, but may not silently erase it.
rules.historicalSpine: World traces record documented consequences; they never create an alternative timeline.
rules.productUse: Traces are state in the living world, not collectibles, badges or completion rewards.
rules.ruptureUse: Civilisational ruptures remain visible but are never converted into score, spectacle or optional play.
